+1 to approving this. A few operational guardrails I’d propose:
- Pool of 200k credits, split into 25 vouchers of 8k each (easier redemption tracking).
- Each voucher valid for 3 months from issue; per-account cap 8k.
- Require simple intake form (name, org, demo plan) and link redemption to HubSpot record for reporting.
- No dedicated SLA or reserved capacity needed; this is promotional. If usage patterns spike, Ops will throttle to maintain SLOs.

I can approve up to 250k from my promo budget; if we want more we’ll need a cross-org sign-off. Prefer to use "Promotions Q4" budget code.
